drafter.private_reasoning: This is the initial draft from opposing counsel, and it is missing specific terms, including the base salary, severance amount, and certain key protections for our client (Vireo Systems Inc.). There are also no provisions on bonus eligibility, performance targets, grounds for termination with cause, or IP/confidentiality clauses. To move the negotiation forward while protecting Vireo, my goal is to ensure clarity, add terms favorable to the company (including clear cause for termination and comprehensive IP/Confidentiality clauses), and ensure all compensation is at the company's discretion regarding bonuses. I am not revealing any financial details from our client and am only requesting 'Base Salary' be subject to further negotiation.

Dear Bellweather Croft LLP,

Thank you for sharing your draft Executive Employment Agreement. Please see our mark-up attached for your review. We have included additional detail on compensation, severance, and key clauses clarifying the parties' intentions and protecting proprietary information. Several commercial terms, including the Base Salary and Severance Amount, are noted as 'to be agreed.' We look forward to your feedback.

Kind regards,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive a Base Salary (amount to be agreed) payable in accordance with the Company’s standard payroll practice. The Executive may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, subject to the Company’s bonus plan as may be in effect from time to time, and at the Company’s sole discretion. The Executive will be eligible for participation in all benefit plans offered to similarly situated employees.

3. SEVERANCE. On termination by the Company without cause, the Executive shall receive a severance payment in an amount to be agreed, subject to the Executive executing a standard release of claims and continued ongoing compliance with Section 4 (Non-Compete), Section 5 (Confidentiality), and Section 6 (Intellectual Property).

4. NON-COMPETE. The Executive shall not, directly or indirectly, compete with the Company, or solicit its customers, clients, or employees, for twelve (12) months after departure. The scope and territorial restrictions shall be specified in a schedule attached hereto.

5. CONFIDENTIALITY. The Executive shall not at any time, either during or after employment, disclose or use any of the Company’s confidential or proprietary information, except as required by law or as authorized in writing by the Company.

6. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. All inventions, developments, and works created by the Executive during employment that relate to the Company’s business shall be the exclusive property of the Company. The Executive agrees to assign and take all necessary steps to confirm such ownership to the Company.

7. TERMINATION FOR CAUSE. The Company may terminate this Agreement immediately for cause, including but not limited to dishonesty, gross misconduct, material breach of this Agreement, or violation of law.

Dear Colleagues,

Thank you for your email. Please see our detailed proposals on the principal commercial terms below. Subject to final agreement on the full terms of the agreement, our client is prepared to propose:

- Base Salary: USD 410,000 per annum, payable in accordance with the Company’s standard payroll practices.
- Severance: On termination by the Company without cause, Executive shall receive a severance payment equal to 12 months’ Base Salary, subject to the standard release of claims and continued compliance with Sections 4–6.

We do not have additional substantive changes to propose at this time beyond these commercial terms. If you require further clarification, please let us know. We look forward to your feedback.

Kind regards,
Aldous Finch LLP
